observations: Black three-tier console chassis characteristic of a PS4 Pro.
Two DualShock 4 controllers, one white and one black.
Sony logo visible on the front left of the console in photo 1.
PlayStation logo visible on the top center in photo 0.
A red warning sticker on the console reads 'WARNING DO NOT CONNECT TO INTERNET'.
The console surface shows some smudges and signs of handling.

claims.evidence: Origin cannot be confirmed from photos; 'neat' is subjective and the unit shows smudges.
The three-tier design shown in photos 1 and 2 is unique to the PS4 Pro model.
No physical game discs are shown, and there is no photo of the console's digital library.

risks.risk: The console may be jailbroken or banned from PlayStation Network (PSN).
risks.proof: A photo of the 'System Information' screen showing the firmware version and a video of a successful PSN login.
risks.if_unproven: as a console with no online functionality.

risks.risk: The 11 games may be pirated digital copies that are lost if the system is updated.
risks.proof: Photos of physical game discs or a list of purchased digital titles.

risks.risk: Internal storage capacity is unconfirmed (1TB or 2TB).
risks.proof: A photo of the 'Storage' settings screen.

risks.risk: Controllers may have hidden faults like stick drift.
risks.proof: A video showing the controllers being used to navigate menus without issues.

proof_requests: Photo of the console turned on showing the 'System Information' screen.
Photo of the 'Storage' screen in settings.
Photos of the 11 games (discs or screen capture of the library).
Video of the console running a game to verify the disc drive and controllers.
response.reason: The item is identifiable as a PS4 Pro with two controllers. The warning sticker strongly suggests a jailbroken state or a network ban, so it is priced at the worst case of having no online access and no verifiable games.
